index.title: Create a Standing Work Inbox
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Work (Work Door). Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Create a Standing Work Inbox. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different
index.what_happened_excerpt: A user created a Grok Bot prompt that established a standing work inbox and a work room with a specialist to handle tasks without doing the work itself. The prompt was shared publicly and listed as a public Grok Bot prompt.
